item.title: Banking Circle Funding Maintenance
item.description:
THIS IS A SCHEDULED EVENT Oct 12, 18:00 - 18:30 UTC

Sep 30, 09:22 UTC
Scheduled - Our funding provider, Banking Circle, will be conducting scheduled maintenance on October 12 at 18:00 UTC for approximately 30 minutes.

During this time, new clients and clients using Banking Circle for the first time may be temporarily unable to set up EUR and GBP deposits or withdrawals while virtual account creation and updates are unavailable.

Existing clients who have previously used Banking Circle for deposits or withdrawals are not expected to be impacted. We will provide updates as they become available.

item.title: Derivatives Maker Protection — Phase 2
item.description:
Oct 8, 07:01 UTC
Completed - The scheduled maintenance has been completed.

Oct 8, 07:00 UTC
In progress - Scheduled maintenance is currently in progress. We will provide updates as necessary.

Oct 7, 11:09 UTC
Scheduled - We will be enabling Maker Protection on our next batch of markets – 61 perpetuals taking our total count with Maker Protection to 100.

This will be rolled out starting at 7 UTC. The source of truth remains the makerProtectionMillis field in the  /instruments feed.

This change is live in UAT for testing.

Docs: https://docs.kraken.com/exchange/guides/futures/maker-protection#phase-2-markets-8-october-2026
